```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
```
```
    }
}
```

```
      @ ensures ((long)a + (long)b) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
        int n = a.length;
```
```
        int m = a[0].length;
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {

        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

    }
```

```
public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

```
public class Add {
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@  ensures \result == false;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    //@ requires adjacencyMat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < adjacencyMat.length;
    //@               adjacencyMat[k] != null && adjacencyMat[k].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= j && j < adjacencyMat.length;
    //@                        adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        /* Outer loop invariants:
         * - i stays within bounds
         * - all pairs (p,q) with 0 <= p < i and p < q < nVert have been checked and are symmetric
         */
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < i && 0 <= q && q < nVert && p < q;
        //@                 adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases nVert - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            /* Inner loop invariants:
             * - j stays within bounds (starts at i+1)
             * - symmetry holds for all previously checked pairs (p,q) with p < q and p < i, or for pairs (i, j') with i+1 <= j' < j

            //@ loop_writes j;

                }
            }
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}

```

```
public class Mul {
    //@  requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@  requires y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (long)x * (long)y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        //@ maintaining res == (long)i * (long)n;
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases m - i;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long)i * (long)n + j;
            //@ loop_writes res, j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @ requires mat != null;
      @ // all rows non-null
      @ requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r < mat.length; mat[r] != null);
      @ // all rows have same length (vacuously true if mat.length==0)
      @ requires mat.length == 0 || (\forall int r; 0 <= r < mat.length; mat[r].length == mat[0].length);
      @

      @
      @ // result is true iff every element equals its top-left neighbor (for indices >=1)
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @           (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||

      @           (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
      @           (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)
      @         )
      @     )
      @     &&
      @     // middle digit constraint for odd length
      @     (digits.length % 2 == 0 ||
      @       (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 ||

      @        digits[digits.length / 2] == 8))

      @ behaviors complete;

              @                  (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6))

              @ loop_writes i, a, b;
              @ decreases len/2 - i;
              @*/
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @                \result[i][j] == A[A.length-1-i][A[0].length-1-j]);
      @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;
```

```
        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k && k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
          @ decreases m - i;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        /*@
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
```
```
          @ maintaining ret != null;
          @ maintaining ret.length == m;
```

```
          @ maintaining (\forall int x; 0 <= x && x < i; \forall int y; 0 <= y && y < n;
          @                 ret[x][y] == A[m-1-x][n-1-y]);
          @ 
          @ // Global fact about indices within [0,n):
          @ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y && y < n; 0 <= n-1-y && n-1-y < n);
          @ decreases m - i;
          @*/

            /*@
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @ maintaining 0 <= i && i < m;
              @ maintaining (\forall int x; 0 <= x && x < m; A[x] != null && A[x].length == n);
              @ maintaining ret[i] != null && ret[i].length == n;
              @ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y && y < j; ret[i][y] == A[m-1-i][n-1-y]);
```

Explanation of changes:
- Added a small, explicit invariant that is independent of the loop variable: (\forall int y; 0 <= y && y < n; 0 <= n-1-y && n-1-y < n). This gives the prover the needed fact that n-1-y is a valid index for all y in the range and avoids "possibly/undefined negative index" failures when reasoning about n-1-j inside the inner loop.
- Kept the other invariants but strengthened the implication to (j <= n-1) ==> ... to make the bound explicit for j-values within the valid range.

```
      // result is the index of the first element that has a duplicate later
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        /*@ 
          @ // check all rows are non-null and of same length n
          @ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k && k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        /*@
          @ // outer loop: rows processed so far are correct
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
          @                 (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < n;
          @                     ret[p][q] == A[m - 1 - p][n - 1 - q]));
          @ loop_writes ret[*][*], i;
          @ decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // inner loop: columns processed so far in row i are correct
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @ maintaining (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < j;
              @                 ret[i][q] == A[m - 1 - i][n - 1 - q]);
              @ loop_writes ret[i][*], j;
              @ decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {

        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {

            sign = -sign;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

assistant: The problem was that the verifier could not prove that c[i] is a non-null array of length m when it checked the body of the inner loop. The body needs c[i] != null and j < c[i].length to be established; the original outer-loop invariants only stated that rows 0..i-1 had the correct shape, so at the moment the inner loop starts the prover did not know the shape of row i.

Solution: state as an (outer) loop invariant that every row of c has been allocated and has length m. This lets the prover conclude c[i] != null and c[i].length == m inside the inner loop, so accesses c[i][j] are defined.

Here is the corrected JML (only the specifications are changed — the Java code is unchanged):

```
public class MatrixSum {
    /*@ 
      @ requires a != null;
      @ requires b != null;
      @ requires a.length > 0;
      @ // all rows of a are non-null and have the same length
      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] != null && a[i].length == a[0].length);
      @ // b has same shape as a
      @ requires b.length == a.length;
      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < b.length; b[i] != null && b[i].length == a[0].length);
      @ 
      @ // Method does not modify any pre-existing memory reachable from parameters or statics
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ 
      @ // Result is a fresh n-by-m matrix whose entries are the sums of a and b.
      @ ensures \fresh(\result);
      @ ensures \result.length == a.length;
      @ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] != null && \result[i].length == a[0].length);
      @ ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[0].length;
      @            \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]);
      @ 
      @ // Inputs are not modified
      @ ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[0].length;
      @           a[i][j] == \old(a[i][j]) && b[i][j] == \old(b[i][j]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        /*@ 
          @ // Java semantics: new int[n][m] yields an array of length n whose rows are non-null arrays of length m.
          @ assert c.length == n;
          @ assert (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < n; c[p] != null && c[p].length == m);
          @*/

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < n; c[p] != null && c[p].length == m);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p < i && 0 <= q < m; c[p][q] == a[p][q] + b[p][q]);
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i < n;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= m;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p < i && 0 <= q < m; c[p][q] == a[p][q] + b[p][q]);
            //@ maintaining (\forall int q; 0 <= q < j; c[i][q] == a[i][q] + b[i][q]);
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

Explanation of the key change:
- Added the outer-loop invariant
  (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < n; c[p] != null && c[p].length == m)
  so the prover can conclude, at the start of the inner loop, that c[i] is a valid row of length m. With that plus the inner loop condition j < m, the index c[i][j] is provably within bounds.

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    /*@ 
      @   // Behavior when input is null: return null, no heap is modified.
      @   requires arr == null;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == null;
      @ also
      @   // Behavior when input is non-null: return a fresh array ret of same length,
      @   // preserving whitespace and converting characters as in the implementation:
      @   // - whitespace characters are copied unchanged,
      @   // - a character at index k is title-cased if it is not whitespace and it
      @   //   is at the start of a word (k == 0 or arr[k-1] is whitespace),
      @   // - otherwise the character is lower-cased.
      @   requires arr != null;
      @   assigns \result, \result[*];
      @   ensures \result != null;
      @   ensures \fresh(\result);
      @   ensures \result.length == arr.length;
      @   ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < arr.length;
      @               (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> \result[k] == arr[k])
      @            && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) && (k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1]))
      @                  ==> \result[k] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[k]))
      @            && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) && !(k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1]))
      @                  ==> \result[k] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[k]))
      @           );
      @   behavior complete;
      @   behavior disjoint;
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        /*@
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @   // For all processed indices j < i, ret[j] satisfies the specification
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @                   (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j])
          @                && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))
          @                      ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]))
          @                && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && !(j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))
          @                      ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
          @               );
          @   // wordStart accurately reflects whether position i is a start of a word
          @   maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]));
          @   loop_writes ret[*], i, wordStart;
          @   decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
```

```
      @            && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) && !(k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1]))
      @                  ==> \result[k] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[k]))
      @           );
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        /*@
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @                   (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j])
          @                && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))
          @                      ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]))
          @                && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && !(j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))
          @                      ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
          @               );
          @   maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]));
          @   loop_writes ret[*], i, wordStart;
          @   decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @ ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < a.length; \result[k] == a[k]);
      @ ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < b.length; \result[k + a.length] == b[k]);
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        /*@
          @ // copy a[0..m-1] into ret[0..m-1]
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
          @ loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @ decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        /*@
          @ // copy b[0..n-1] into ret[m..m+n-1], preserving a part
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < m; ret[j] == a[j]);
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j]);
          @ loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@      && (lo <= val && val <= hi ==> \result == val);
    public static int clamp(int hi, int lo, int val) {
        if (val > hi)
            return hi;
        if (val < lo)
            return lo;
        return val;
    }
}
```

```
    /*@ 
      @  // Behavior when array is null or empty: nothing is modified and result is -1
      @  requires arr == null || arr.length == 0;
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @  ensures \result == -1;

      @  also
      @
      @  // Behavior when array is non-null and non-empty:
      @  requires arr != null && arr.length > 0;
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @
      @  // If there is no duplicate pair (p<q) with arr[p]==arr[q], result is -1
      @  ensures (\result == -1) <==> (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p < q && q < arr.length; arr[p] != arr[q]);
      @
      @  // If there is a duplicate, result is the smallest index i such that
      @  // there exists j>i with arr[i]==arr[j].
      @  ensures \result != -1 ==>
      @            (0 <= \result && \result < arr.length-1
      @             && (\exists int j; \result < j && j < arr.length; arr[\result] == arr[j])
      @             && (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < \result; (\forall int j; k < j && j < arr.length ==> arr[k] != arr[j])));
      @
      @  behaviors disjoint;
      @  behaviors complete;
      @ */
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        /*@ 
          @   // Outer loop: i ranges from 0 .. arr.length-2
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= arr.length - 1;
          @   // For all indices p < i there is no later duplicate of arr[p]
          @   maintaining \forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i; (\forall int q; p < q && q < arr.length ==> arr[p] != arr[q]);

          @   decreases arr.length - i;

              @   // Inner loop: j ranges from i+1 .. arr.length-1
              @   maintaining i + 1 <= j && j <= arr.length;
              @   // So far in inner loop, arr[i] differs from arr[k] for all previously checked k

              @   // Outer invariant remains true inside inner loop
              @   maintaining \forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i; (\forall int q; p < q && q < arr.length ==> arr[p] != arr[q]);
              @   loop_writes j;
              @   decreases arr.length - j;
              @*/
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @     && (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < a.length && 0 <= j && j < a.length;
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {

                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
```

```
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j+1 < n && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j+1]);

        //@ decreases n - i;

                inc = false;

            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
```

```
      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] != null);
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
          @ decreases (len/2) - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int bottom2 = rec2[1];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
```

```
    public static boolean isLeapYear(int year) {

                if (year % 400 == 0)
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
```

```
      @*/
```

```
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        /* Outer loop invariants:
           - i is always between 1 and n (so it is non-negative),

           The loop decreases measure ensures termination even when m or n are 0 or 1.
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {

                return null;

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}

```

```
    //@     (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < q && q < nums.length ==> nums[p] + nums[q] != target) &&
    //@     \result.length == 0 && \fresh(\result)
    //@   )
    //@ );
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < q && q < n && p < i; nums[p] + nums[q] != target);
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int q; i+1 <= q && q < j; nums[i] + nums[q] != target);
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }

```
```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```
Rules (apply all, exactly as written):

```
public class IsIdentity {
    /*@ 
      @ // Case: null or empty array -> false
      @ requires a == null || a.length == 0;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == false;
      @ also
      @ // Case: non-null, non-empty array -> result true iff a is an n x n identity matrix
      @ requires a != null && a.length > 0;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length;
      @                         a[i] != null
      @                      && a[i].length == a.length
      @                      && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length;
      @                               (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0)));
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        /*@ 
          @ // Outer loop invariant: rows 0..i-1 have been fully validated as identity rows
          @ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
          @ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
          @              a[k] != null && a[k].length == n
          @           && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < n; (k == j ? a[k][j] == 1 : a[k][j] == 0));
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            /*@ 
              @ // Inner loop invariant: for current row i, columns 0..j-1 satisfy identity condition
              @ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
              @ maintaining a[i] != null && a[i].length == n;
              @ maintaining \forall int jj; 0 <= jj < j;
              @              (i == jj ? a[i][jj] == 1 : a[i][jj] == 0);
              @ loop_writes j;
              @ decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @
      @ also

      @ // Case: non-empty array -> boolean characterisation of strobogrammatic
      @ public normal_behavior
      @   requires digits != null && digits.length > 0;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == (
      @       (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < digits.length/2;
      @           ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[digits.length-1-j] == 0) ||
      @            (digits[j] == 1 && digits[digits.length-1-j] == 1) ||
      @            (digits[j] == 8 && digits[digits.length-1-j] == 8) ||
      @            (digits[j] == 6 && digits[digits.length-1-j] == 9) ||
      @            (digits[j] == 9 && digits[digits.length-1-j] == 6))
      @       )
      @       &&
      @       (digits.length % 2 == 0 ||
      @           (digits[digits.length/2] == 0 ||
      @            digits[digits.length/2] == 1 ||
      @            digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
      @   );
      @
      @ disjoint behaviors;
      @ complete behaviors;

    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {

          @        (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len-1-j] == 8) ||
          @        (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len-1-j] == 9) ||
          @        (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len-1-j] == 6));
          @   loop_writes i, a, b;
          @   decreases len/2 - i;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }

            sign = -sign;

}
```

```
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;

        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```
```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

```

```
public class ClosedInterval {
    //@ // Case: a > b -> return null, no heap modification.
    //@ requires a > b;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == null;
    //@ also
    //@ // Case: a <= b and the interval size is safe for array allocation.
    //@ requires a <= b && ((long)b - (long)a + 1) <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null;
    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@ ensures \result.length == b - a + 1;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < \result.length; \result[i] == a + i);
    public static int[] closedInterval(int a, int b) {
        if (a > b) return null;

        int n = b - a + 1;
        int[] arr = new int[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; arr[j] == a + j;
        //@ loop_writes arr[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = a + i;
        }

        return arr;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();

        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
```

```
    //@         \result == 100 || \result == 500 || \result == 1000 || \result == -1;

                return 100;
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;

                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @             ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 0)
      @           || (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 1)
      @           || (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 8)
      @           || (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 9)
      @           || (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 6))
      @         )
      @         &&
      @         (digits.length % 2 == 0
      @           || (digits[digits.length/2] == 0
      @               || digits[digits.length/2] == 1
      @               || digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
      @       )
      @ );
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

          @   || (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - 1 - j] == 6));
          @ loop_writes i, a, b;
          @ decreases (len/2) - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

            }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {

                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
```

```
      @  ensures (\exists int j; \result+1 <= j < arr.length; arr[\result] == arr[j]);
      @  ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k < \result; (\forall int l; k+1 <= l < arr.length; arr[k] != arr[l]));
      @ also
      @ // Case: array without duplicates -> return -1
      @  requires arr != null && arr.length > 0 && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; (\forall int j; i+1 <= j < arr.length; arr[i] != arr[j]));
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @  ensures \result == -1;
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        /*@ 
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= arr.length - 1;
          @   // For all indices k < i there is no duplicate of arr[k] later in the array
          @   maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; (\forall int l; k+1 <= l < arr.length; arr[k] != arr[l]));
          @   loop_writes i;
          @   decreases arr.length - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            /*@
              @   maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= arr.length;
              @   // For the current i, elements arr[i+1..j-1] are all different from arr[i]
              @   maintaining (\forall int k; i+1 <= k < j; arr[i] != arr[k]);
              @   loop_writes j;
              @   decreases arr.length - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                if (arr[i] == arr[j]) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {

        long res = 0;
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@  requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE && y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        /* Outer loop: after each completed iteration i (0..m-1) the accumulated
           result equals i * n. */
        //@ maintaining 0 <= m;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= n;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= res && res <= (long)m * (long)n;
        //@ maintaining res == (long)i * (long)n;
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /* Inner loop: during iteration, when j ranges 0..n, res equals
               i*n + j (j is the number of increments already performed in
               the current inner loop). */
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long)i * (long)n + j;
            //@ loop_writes res, j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```
