```
      @          // for the chosen i, no earlier j (between i+1 and chosen j-1) produces a match
      @          (\forall int jj; \result[0]+1 <= jj && jj < \result[1] ==> nums[\result[0]] + nums[jj] != target)
      @         );
      @ 
      @ // If no such pair exists, result is a fresh empty array.
      @ ensures ( !(\exists int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length;
      @                 (\exists int j; i+1 <= j && j < nums.length && nums[i] + nums[j] == target)) )
      @         ==> (\fresh(\result) && \result.length == 0);
      @*/
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < i;
        //@               (\forall int jj; ii+1 <= jj && jj < n ==> nums[ii] + nums[jj] != target));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int jj; i+1 <= jj && jj < j ==> nums[i] + nums[jj] != target);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
```
```
            }
```
```
        }
        return true;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```
```
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
```
```
            }
```
```
        }
        return true;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    /*@ 
      @ // Case: empty matrix
      @  requires mat != null && mat.length == 0;
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @  ensures \result == true;
      @ also
      @ // Case: non-empty matrix: all rows non-null and same length (rectangular)
      @  requires mat != null && mat.length > 0;
      @  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r < mat.length; mat[r] != null);
      @  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r < mat.length - 1; mat[r].length == mat[r+1].length);
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 1 <= i < mat.length; \forall int j; 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1]);
      @ behaviors disjoint, complete;
      @*/
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        /*@ 
          @ // outer loop: iterate rows from 1..n-1
          @ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= mat.length;
          @ maintaining \forall int ii; 1 <= ii < i; \forall int jj; 1 <= jj < mat[0].length; mat[ii][jj] == mat[ii-1][jj-1];
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases mat.length - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // inner loop: check diagonal equality across columns 1..m-1 for current row i
              @ maintaining 1 <= j && j <= mat[0].length;
              @ maintaining \forall int jj; 1 <= jj < j; mat[i][jj] == mat[i-1][jj-1];
              @ loop_writes j;
              @ decreases mat[0].length - j;
```
```
              @*/
```

```
                }
```

```
        /*@

          @ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= mat.length;
          @ maintaining \forall int ii; 1 <= ii < i; \forall int jj; 1 <= jj < mat[0].length; mat[ii][jj] == mat[ii-1][jj-1];
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases mat.length - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {

              @ // inner loop: check diagonal equality across columns 1..m-1 for current row i

              @ decreases mat[0].length - j;
```

```
                    return false;
                }
```
```
            }

        return true;
```

```
        if (vec == null) return null;

        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {

            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @ // Behavior when input is non-null and non-empty: result iff all symmetric pairs
      @ // are valid strobogrammatic pairs and the middle digit (if any) is 0,1,8.
      @ public normal_behavior
      @   requires digits != null && digits.length > 0;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == (
      @       (\forall int i; 0 <= i < digits.length/2;
      @            ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
      @       )

      @   );

      @ also
      @   ensures \result == true || \result == false; // explicit boolean result
      @

      @ complete;

          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;

          @                    (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
          @                    (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
          @                    (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6))
          @                );
          @   loop_writes i, a, b;
          @   decreases len/2 - i;
          @*/
```
```
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```
```
        }

        return true;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @ assigns \nothing;
```

```
    public static int add(int x, int y) {

        if (y > 0) {

            }

                n = n - 1;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @   requires a == null || a.length == 0;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == false;
      @ 
      @ // Case: non-null, non-empty arrays: result is true iff a is an n x n identity matrix
      @ also
      @   requires a != null && a.length > 0;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length;
      @                           a[i] != null
      @                           && a[i].length == a.length
      @                           && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length;
      @                                   (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0)));
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        /*@ 
          @   maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
          @   // For all already-checked rows p < i: they are non-null, length n, and have identity-row values
          @   maintaining \forall int p; 0 <= p < i;
          @                a[p] != null
          @                && a[p].length == n
          @                && (\forall int q; 0 <= q < n; (p == q ? a[p][q] == 1 : a[p][q] == 0));
          @   loop_writes i;
          @   decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            /*@
              @   maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
              @   // For columns already checked q < j in row i: they satisfy identity condition for row i
              @   maintaining \forall int q; 0 <= q < j; (i == q ? a[i][q] == 1 : a[i][q] == 0);
              @   loop_writes j;
              @   decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @   requires vec != null;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result != null && \fresh(\result);
      @   ensures \result.length == vec.length;
      @   // For every element, result holds the saturated product
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < vec.length;
      @               ((long)vec[i] * (long)a > Integer.MAX_VALUE
      @                    ==> \result[i] == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
      @            &&
      @               ((long)vec[i] * (long)a < Integer.MIN_VALUE
      @                    ==> \result[i] == Integer.MIN_VALUE)
      @            &&
      @               (((long)vec[i] * (long)a <= Integer.MAX_VALUE
      @                   && (long)vec[i] * (long)a >= Integer.MIN_VALUE)
      @                    ==> \result[i] == (int)((long)vec[i] * (long)a))
      @          );
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        /*@ 
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= vec.length;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @                   ((long)vec[j] * (long)a > Integer.MAX_VALUE
          @                        ==> ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
          @                &&
          @                   ((long)vec[j] * (long)a < Integer.MIN_VALUE
          @                        ==> ret[j] == Integer.MIN_VALUE)
          @                &&
          @                   (((long)vec[j] * (long)a <= Integer.MAX_VALUE
          @                        && (long)vec[j] * (long)a >= Integer.MIN_VALUE)
          @                        ==> ret[j] == (int)((long)vec[j] * (long)a))
          @               );
          @   loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @   decreases vec.length - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @  // Behavior when input is null: return null and do not modify any existing memory
      @  requires arr == null;
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @  ensures \result == null;
      @
      @  also
      @
      @  // Behavior when input is non-null: produce a fresh array of same length
      @  requires arr != null;
      @  assigns \result, \result[*];
      @  ensures \fresh(\result);
      @  ensures \result.length == arr.length;
      @
      @  // For every position i, whitespace characters are preserved;
      @  // non-whitespace characters are title-cased at the start of a word
      @  // (i == 0 or previous character is whitespace) and lower-cased otherwise.
      @  ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < arr.length;
      @             (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i])
      @          && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==>
      @                ((i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]))
      @                     ? \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])
      @                     : \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
      @             )
      @         );
      @
      @  behaviors disjoint, complete;
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;

          @  // For all processed indices j < i, ret[j] already satisfies the postcondition

          @                         : ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
          @                 )
          @            );
          @  // The loop only writes to ret[*] and the loop index i
          @  loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @  decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;

    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```
